body:
## [3.114.0] - 2026-11-24

### Features

- add guarded joining checkout recovery actions
- automatically apply single-use first-purchase benefits

### Bug Fixes

- recover from rejected gift card draft saves
- guard standalone gift card checkout
- share pre-joining manual redemption admission
- skip joining rewards without realized savings
- separate joining monetary targets from bundle claims
- keep recovery dismissal bound to its Multipass route
- guard recovered tenders and reconcile gift points stacking
- keep recovery scheduling out of ordinary balance refreshes
- recheck recovery ownership after asynchronous ledger reads
- retain changed-basket confirmation and captured evidence guards
- use realized prior promotion savings for joining benefits
- price joining benefits after selected gifts and rounded line bases
- reconcile uncapped joining allocations with aggregate ceiling
- include manual points and global discount allocation
- enforce benefit caps on checkout-rounded inputs
- scope and revalidate joining benefits before tender
- retain benefit rollbacks and persist fresh checkout drafts
- preserve renamed Windows launchers
- revalidate free benefits with loaded facts and recover wallet retries
- verify free benefits at deferred wallet capture boundaries
- wait for initial free benefit loading before checkout
- serialize and revalidate free club benefit checkout

### Other Changes

- run pinned legacy bootstrap cases in CI
- run bounded checkout recovery regressions before full suites
- drive widget and persistence clocks during recovery
- cover recovery reasons and durable order parking
- record joining-benefit review validation and Windows checkout
- record Windows rounding and quota acceptance checks
- add follow-up Windows acceptance evidence
- record Rami review Windows acceptance evidence
- preserve PDF guide bytes across platforms
